name: WitnessAI
tagline: Security and governance gateway for enterprise AI use.
description: WitnessAI is a unified security and governance platform for how an organization uses AI. It sits as a gateway over employee and AI-agent interactions, giving security teams three things: observability into all AI activity (including shadow AI), policy enforcement and governance, and protection against prompt injection, data leakage, and other model-layer threats. Each customer runs in an isolated, single-tenant environment encrypted with their own keys.
insight: Founded in 2023 by ex–Palo Alto Networks exec Rick Caccia; raised a $27.5M Series A co-led by GV and Ballistic Ventures.

modelSupport.notes: Observes, governs, and secures use of any AI model or app across the enterprise.

edge: Sits as a gateway over employee and agent AI use — observe, enforce policy, and block prompt-injection/data-leak across any model, not just one app.
pros: Model-agnostic guardrails across all AI use
Visibility into shadow AI / employee usage
Founders from Palo Alto Networks and Exabeam
cons: Enterprise sales motion, no public pricing
Aimed at large orgs, not individuals

references.title: WitnessAI is building guardrails for generative AI models
